reviewer.limitation: Collaborating agent source inspection, not authenticated external/human acceptance, native execution or installed evidence.

scope: I2 unnumbered database capture proposal, typed lossless history/folding/coverage, current-deal internal reader, same-observation pipeline authority and synthetic native test definitions. Includes stage-episode kernel and completeness service adapter source; statistical aggregation source review complete.
result: No remaining definite actionable finding in this source scope after the listed corrections. Source-only conclusion; native/installation qualification remains open.

resolvedFindings.finding: BigInt refinement could run after a lexical failure and throw on malformed text.
resolvedFindings.correction: Validate positive decimal shape and bounded length before BigInt conversion.

resolvedFindings.finding: Command ID UUID parser disagreed with SQL text storage.
resolvedFindings.correction: Accept nonempty opaque text or null; no provenance is inferred.

resolvedFindings.finding: Snapshot lexical shape alone accepted impossible native witnesses.
resolvedFindings.correction: Bound XID8 values and require xmin<=xmax, sorted unique in-progress XIDs within [xmin,xmax). Native PG output assumptions remain explicit.

resolvedFindings.finding: Trigger name, function OID and ALWAYS status did not establish full guard shape.
resolvedFindings.correction: Verify expected event/timing/row bitmask, no WHEN/arguments/column restriction, and noninternal/nondeferrable shape.

resolvedFindings.finding: Historical pipeline IDs came from an earlier READ COMMITTED observation.
resolvedFindings.correction: Evaluate permitted pipelines in the same SQL snapshot as the deal/event facts using the existing shared pipeline predicate.

resolvedFindings.finding: A visible pipeline UUID recreated after deletion could grant an old incarnation history.
resolvedFindings.correction: Require active current pipeline head and matching tip projection; deny any pipeline UUID with prior incarnation evidence pending an event-specific referenced-incarnation resolver.

resolvedFindings.finding: A direct internal caller could supply broad owner filters without the reporting permission ceiling.
resolvedFindings.correction: Reapply can(stats.viewOthers); otherwise restrict owners to the actor, in addition to row visibility. This matches the existing ownerScope policy.

resolvedFindings.finding: A declared open activation baseline could be falsely supplied as observed entry and enter exact quantiles.
resolvedFindings.correction: Reciprocal first-episode censoring rules require baseline left censoring and its lower-bound-only population.

resolvedFindings.finding: A movement exit without its destination episode could be accepted as a complete episode sequence.
resolvedFindings.correction: Check transaction-final movement/destination and closed/reopen continuity, while preserving closed won/lost corrections without invented stays.

privacyBoundary.data: Titles and loss free text, exact deal values/currency/status, source and person/organization/workforce references, visibility, stage/pipeline definitions, microsecond timestamps, revisions, incarnations and native transaction snapshots. Free text can contain personal data.
privacyBoundary.writes: Private SQL proposal, if installed, transactionally captures deal/stage/pipeline baselines and material row changes plus heads. Schema declarations alone create no storage. Report table has no authenticated writer.
privacyBoundary.reads: Internal bounded SELECT of current authorized live deal incarnation; matching state chain and capture tip, same-observation current historical-pipeline authority. Global baseline counts excluded.
privacyBoundary.excluded: No unrestricted custom fields/labels, provider I/O, email, campaign/spending action, object export, verified subject identity, retained-deletion authority or lifecycle operation.
privacyBoundary.retention: Proposed immutable event/baseline/snapshot rows retain previous and deleted-state facts. No qualified retention/erasure adapter exists; immutability does not authorize indefinite retention.
privacyBoundary.registry: Separate analytics inventory classification with all six lifecycle capabilities unsupported.

limitations: Private SQL has no canonical migration ordinal, journal/snapshot or schema-index export; populated upgrade and migration framework transaction integration remain unqualified.
Ordinals/timestamps represent row observation, not commit chronology or imported business events. Baselines do not establish past creation/stage entry.
Catalog health and projection matching do not prove uninterrupted history against privileged DDL/function replacement or an unseen ABA capture gap.
Current deal reader grants no archived/deleted-record history authority; raw contact references, events and transaction snapshots require scoped application/browser/export DTOs.
Reused pipeline UUIDs are deliberately undergranted, including new histories, until referenced-incarnation selection is implemented.
Native tests use constructed actors and private disposable clones. Their definitions do not qualify live sessions/hydration/revocation, provider sources, migration admission or installed use.
Snapshot writer, historical stage definition selection, aggregates/report services/UI and broader programme capabilities remain unfinished.
A complete snapshot-through-cutoff chain is a server repository precondition. Pure kernels cannot detect an omitted later event; ordinal alone never proves completeness.

Pure stage statistics are not an integrated cohort/report collector. A common cutoff string, grouped IDs and valid arithmetic do not qualify common snapshot membership, source eligibility or stage definitions.
execution: Reviewer executed no tests or checks. Root execution receipts are separate and scoped to their actual source cut.

stageEpisodeReview.result: No remaining definite source blocker under transaction-final inactive-state policy.
stageEpisodeReview.policy: Unknown baseline entry remains left-censored; observed completed stays and current open age are distinct. Same-transaction round trips disappear during folding. Archive/delete final states or restoration across transactions remain unavailable. Partial or incomplete repository output is rejected before aging.
stageEpisodeReview.precision: Elapsed spans are exact nanosecond decimal text from Temporal; observed boundaries are not commit or asserted business timestamps.
stageEpisodeReview.authority: Returned facts remain identifiable internal analytics data, including entity/pipeline/stage and event/ordinal witnesses. No anonymization, browser/export qualification or retained-record authority is granted.

statisticsReview.result: No remaining source blocker after reciprocal censoring and episode-continuity amendments.
statisticsReview.arithmetic: Exact BigInt arithmetic midpoint median with half nanoseconds; nearest-rank P75/P90; zero and repeated-visit samples explicit.
statisticsReview.bounds: At most 5,000 deal-incarnation inputs and 50,000 episodes; unsuccessful, duplicated, mixed-frame, contradictory or invalid-quantity inputs fail explicitly.
statisticsReview.censoring: Completed observed-entry durations, current observed-entry ages and baseline lower-bound contributors are separate populations. Baseline declarations are checked reciprocally.
statisticsReview.continuity: Movement exits require the destination episode; closed-state corrections and later reopened stage/pipeline changes remain valid.
statisticsReview.boundary: Matching activation/cutoff metadata cannot prove common MVCC membership, cohort completeness or authority. The future collecting adapter owns that proof. Groups have recorded pipeline/stage IDs only, no historical definition/incarnation/name resolution.

amendments.trigger: Hosted TSC TS2322 at the negative state guard.
amendments.correction: Use explicit missing/unavailable early returns with no assertions or casts. Runtime states and partial/incomplete gate unchanged.
amendments.review: Independent source inspection found no new correctness/privacy issue; no reviewer execution.
